customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash)

name.meaning: customer's full legal name exactly as on the government-issued ID used at onboarding

phone_number.meaning: primary mobile number on the profile; also the number used for payment-reminder texts

email.meaning: primary email address on the profile, lower case, exactly as registered

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth as verified at onboarding

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the Social Security number used for credit underwriting

street_address.meaning: current residential street address (number, street, unit) as on file

city.meaning: city of the current residential address

state.meaning: two-letter USPS code of the state of current residence (may differ from a loan's origination_state if the customer moved)

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the current residential address

profile_created_date.meaning: date the customer profile was first created (first application with Larkspur)

preferred_language.meaning: language the customer chose for disclosures and servicing calls

bank_account_id.meaning: primary id of a linked bank account record

bank_name.meaning: name of the depository institution exactly as on the linked account

account_type.meaning: deposit account type of the linked account

account_last4.meaning: last four digits of the deposit account number

routing_number.meaning: ABA routing number of the depository institution

verification_status.meaning: ownership-verification status of the linked account: verified via instant verification or confirmed micro-deposits; pending_microdeposit while micro-deposits are unconfirmed; failed if verification failed; closed once an ACH return R02/R03/R04 or the customer reports the account closed

linked_date.meaning: date the account was linked to the customer profile

loan_id.meaning: primary id of the personal loan account

variant_name.meaning: rate grade assigned at underwriting, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the loan (basis defined in the loan charter lifecycle.states)

loan_purpose.meaning: loan purpose the borrower selected on the application; refinance_existing_loan for a loan whose proceeds pay off an existing Larkspur loan

origination_state.meaning: state of residence at application; it fixes the governing state fee schedule for the life of the loan even if the borrower later moves

approval_date.meaning: date underwriting approved the loan; empty before approval

funding_date.meaning: date the loan was funded (proceeds disbursed); interest accrues from this date; empty before funding

maturity_date.meaning: date of the final scheduled installment under the current schedule; empty before funding

closed_date.meaning: date the loan reached paid_off or settled; empty while open

charged_off_date.meaning: date the loan was charged off; empty unless it has been charged off

term_months.meaning: repayment term in months chosen at application

amount_financed.meaning: loan amount (principal at funding), including the origination fee deducted from proceeds

origination_fee_amount.meaning: origination fee charged at funding, deducted from the loan amount before disbursement

net_proceeds.meaning: amount_financed minus origination_fee_amount; what the borrower or the borrower's creditors received

base_interest_rate.format: annual rate in percent, 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.49 means 12.49%)
base_interest_rate.meaning: contract simple interest rate before any AutoPay discount, fixed at approval

autopay_enrolled.meaning: whether recurring AutoPay debits are currently set up on this loan

autopay_bank_account_id.meaning: linked bank account AutoPay debits (foreign key -> bank_accounts); empty when not enrolled

direct_pay_discount_applied.meaning: whether the direct-pay rate discount was granted at funding (debt consolidation proceeds sent directly to creditors)

current_interest_rate.format: annual rate in percent, 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.49 means 12.49%)
current_interest_rate.meaning: simple interest rate currently accruing: base rate minus discounts in force, or the rate set by an active hardship or servicemember benefit

apr.format: annual rate in percent, 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.49 means 12.49%)
apr.meaning: annual percentage rate disclosed at approval (includes the origination fee)

payment_due_day.meaning: day of month each installment is due

next_due_date.meaning: due date of the oldest installment not yet paid in full; earlier than today means the loan is past due

interest_paid_through_date.meaning: date through which accrued simple interest has been paid; interest for later days is still accruing

principal_balance.meaning: unpaid principal; identically the sum of the principal account deltas

fees_balance.meaning: unpaid late fees and returned-payment fees; identically the sum of the fees_due account deltas

amount_past_due.meaning: sum of installment amounts due on or before today that remain unpaid; 0.00 when current

refinanced_from_loan_id.meaning: for a refinance loan, the existing Larkspur loan its proceeds pay off (foreign key -> loans); empty otherwise

closure_reason.meaning: why the loan closed; empty while open

loan_id.meaning: loan the line posts to (foreign key -> loans)

txn_date.meaning: effective date of the line (payment effective date, fee assessment date, return date, disbursement date)

payment_type.meaning: what a payment was intended for; empty on non-payment lines
